colour_sources.name: Miniature Painter Pro miniature-paints — Rick Fleuren (MIT)
colour_sources.method: Imported directly from the pinned upstream Markdown tables. Approximate manufacturer/community RGB/hex values; not laboratory measurements. Existing Paint Commons records and manufacturer swatches take precedence. Per-row source URLs and decisions: reports/arcturus-import/decisions.json.

colour_sources.name: GERInFact — TTC–Citadel Converter numeric swatches
colour_sources.method: Exact paint-name matches to the pinned numeric dataset. Hex values uppercased; no image sampling or Citadel equivalences imported. Used for 30 new Dark Arts paints; existing-colour differences are separate pending-review proposals. Snapshot and provenance: data/upstream/gerinfact-235dc3f/.

barcode_sources.name: Calculated from the product code
barcode_sources.method: The Army Painter and Vallejo encode the product code in the EAN-13; the barcode is derived from the code and its check digit.

barcode_sources.method: Read from a product listing; each barcode keeps its source_url.

barcode_sources.method: Submitted from a scan in Stipplewise and approved in review.
